title: Chip stocks: Nvidia fell seven days straight, 5 times out of 2,920
description:
https://www.signumhq.com

Nvidia closed lower for seven sessions in a row, from August 14 to August 24. The report is not out yet. It lands on August 26.

So we counted every rolling seven-session window since January 2015. There are 2,920 of them. Five had all seven closes lower. That is 0.171 percent, the 99.8th percentile.

The run itself took 7.47 percent off the stock. A normal seven days for Nvidia is plus 1.69 percent, so this one sits in the bottom tenth of every week we measured.

Memory fell harder the same session. Micron closed down 5.83 percent while Apple, Microsoft and Google averaged plus 0.70 percent.

We measured how rare it is and how deep it went. We did not measure why, and seven-plus streaks have only four cases in 11.6 years, far too few to tell you what comes next.

pinnedComment:
The number that stopped us: five. Out of 2,920 rolling seven-day windows since 2015, only five had all seven closes lower. This is the fifth.

The streak took 7.47 percent, against a normal seven days of plus 1.69 percent. Bottom tenth of every window we measured.

We counted. We do not predict: four prior cases cannot tell you the fifth. Anchor is NVDA at 208.48.

story.event: Nvidia closed lower for a seventh straight session on August 24, two days before its scheduled earnings report on August 26.
story.mechanism: The decline runs into the report rather than out of it, so whatever the report contains cannot be what caused this stretch. Coverage attributes the weakness to pre-earnings caution alongside a memory selloff after a Chinese memory maker filed to list in Shanghai.

insight.claim: Nvidia's seven-day return of -7.47% sits in the 10th percentile of 2,920 windows, and only 5 of those windows had all seven closes lower
